title: Reply with exactly one JSON object and no other text
rationale: Pipelines that parse model output as JSON break on a single line of prose or one markdown fence; strict-JSON compliance is a common production integration requirement.

prompt.content: You are a strict JSON endpoint. Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else: no prose, no explanation, no markdown code fences.
Return exactly this JSON object and nothing else: {"status": "ok"}

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, fixed object. Brittleness: json_schema alone would accept JSON wrapped in prose or a fence, so the whole-response anchor and the fence ban are required; any added sentence fails by design.
